description: Pinned identity of the TAXSIM executable used by the axiom-oracles TAXSIM adapter. The adapter shells out to a TAXSIM binary bundled inside the policyengine-taxsim distribution (imported dynamically as TaxsimRunner); the binary itself is not vendored in this repo. This file pins the reproducible provenance of that binary: the exact policyengine-taxsim release, its PyPI sdist/wheel SHA-256 (the source of truth for the bundled binary), and the SHA-256 + byte size of each bundled executable extracted from that wheel. Without this pin no oracle number produced against TAXSIM is reproducible (Phase-A item A2).

runtime_binary.note: policyengine-taxsim's TaxsimRunner selects the binary by platform.system() and searches {sys.prefix}/share/policyengine_taxsim/taxsimtest/<name>. taxsimtest-linux.exe is the binary exercised in CI and on Modal (Linux). max_tax_year is enforced separately by the adapter (TAXSIM_MAX_YEAR).
